title: Deconfounding Game 5: extended M-bias
content: The extended M-graph adds childhood asthma as a cause of smoking and a proposed smoking-to-adult-asthma effect. Adjusting for childhood asthma closes one back-door path but opens the M-shaped path unless another variable closes it; asthma predisposition alone is sufficient.

variables.name: Parental Smoking (A)
variables.content: A cause of both the individual's smoking and childhood asthma.

variables.name: Smoking (X)
variables.content: The exposure whose effect on adult asthma is sought.

variables.name: Childhood Asthma (B)
variables.content: A cause of smoking and collider of parental smoking with predisposition.

variables.name: Asthma Predisposition (C)
variables.content: An unobservable common cause of childhood and adult asthma.

variables.name: Adult Asthma (Y)
variables.content: The outcome with a proposed causal arrow from smoking.

arrows.because: Parental smoking influences later smoking behavior.
Parental smoking can influence childhood asthma.
The same predisposition influences adult asthma.
Childhood asthma can influence later smoking behavior.
This is the proposed smoking effect on adult asthma.
